snippet.title: B.O.S.S. Official Trailer | Free Online Board Game
snippet.description:
Everybody wanna be the boss... but everybody gotta pay that cost.

B.O.S.S. (Business Operations Survival Strategy) is a free online board game for 2 to 4 players. Roll the dice, make deals and race your friends to $1,000,000. Voice chat built in, nothing to download.

Play free: https://bossgame.fun
Discord: https://discord.gg/6k8zYPn4SP
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/bossgamefun

Music: Everybody Wanna Be The Boss (Boss Radio, Nova Studios)
